workflow: Northline Goods: store associate, US (CA, TX)

states_verified.CA: Confirmed by Northline payroll lead on 2026-10-30 against the state checklist
states_verified.TX: Confirmed by Northline payroll lead on 2026-10-30 against the state checklist

stop_rule.when: Background result cannot be cleared under the hiring policy, or a moved first shift is missed

steps.action: Call the hire to confirm the first-shift date
steps.done_when: Call logged on the hire record with the confirmed date

steps.action: Send the background check disclosure and authorization form
steps.done_when: Signed authorization stored on the hire record
steps.legal_basis: Written authorization before ordering a consumer report; confirmed by Northline legal on 2026-10-30

fallback.action: Text the hire the form link again with the deadline

steps.action: Order the background check from the screening vendor
steps.done_when: Vendor portal shows a final result for the hire
steps.needs: the signed authorization, which the vendor requires before running the check

fallback.action: Send the vendor a second request quoting the order number

steps.action: Create the hire's register login and staff badge
steps.done_when: Login opens the till on the store test terminal
steps.needs: a cleared background result before anyone gets till access

fallback.action: Pair the hire with a trained cashier, no till access on shift one

steps.action: Send the hire the Form I-9 Section 1 link
steps.done_when: Section 1 signed and dated in the I-9 system

fallback.action: Call the hire; if Section 1 cannot be signed by day 0, move the shift

steps.action: Examine the hire's original documents and sign Section 2
steps.done_when: Section 2 signed in the I-9 system with document details

fallback.action: Ask the hire to bring the missing document to their next shift

steps.action: Create the E-Verify case from the finished Form I-9
steps.done_when: E-Verify case number saved on the hire record
steps.needs: the finished Form I-9, which E-Verify reads

steps.action: Send the hire the Form W-4 in the payroll portal
steps.done_when: Payroll portal shows the W-4 as submitted

fallback.action: Text the hire the portal link and the day-0 deadline

steps.action: Submit the new hire report to the state agency
steps.done_when: State confirmation number saved in payroll
steps.needs: the hire's legal name, address and SSN from the W-4

steps.action: Send the hire the direct deposit form in the payroll portal
steps.done_when: Payroll portal shows the deposit account verified

fallback.action: Issue the first wages on a pay card; switch at the next cycle

steps.action: Send the handbook and attendance policy for e-signature
steps.done_when: Signed acknowledgement stored in the hire's file

fallback.action: Hire signs the paper copy in the first ten minutes of shift one

steps.done_when: Learning system shows the module passed

fallback.action: Book the module as paid time and move the first shift by one day

steps.action: Assign the ladder safety sign-off to stockroom hires
steps.done_when: Signed ladder sign-off stored in the hire's file

fallback.action: Keep the hire off ladder tasks until the sign-off is filed

steps.action: Enter the hire's first two weeks of shifts in the rota
steps.done_when: Shifts visible in the hire's scheduling app

fallback.action: Text the hire the shift times directly from the paper rota

steps.action: Order the uniform in the size the hire gave at offer
steps.done_when: Order confirmation number saved on the hire record

fallback.action: Issue a uniform from store stock on day one

steps.action: Text the hire their first-week shift times
steps.done_when: Text shows delivered in the messaging tool
steps.needs: the shifts entered in the rota

steps.action: Tell the hire the check cleared and which documents to bring
steps.done_when: Text shows delivered in the messaging tool

steps.action: Text the hire tomorrow's start time, parking and who to ask for
steps.done_when: Text shows delivered in the messaging tool
